integrity: The generator polynomial is reconstructed directly from the source. The six shifted rows have rank \(6\), the complete \(64\)-word distribution has minimum weight \(6\), and all \(2824\) positive-dimensional message subspaces are enumerated exactly once in reduced-row-echelon form.
scientific_limitations: The result is an exact finite higher-support census for the \(m=4\) code in Example 2. It does not give an all-parameter formula for the full cyclic family and does not classify subcodes up to automorphism.
title: Complete higher-support profile of the distance-optimal binary cyclic \([15,6,6]\) code
